topic: A traveler's flight is delayed, causing them to miss an important event
text: I hear the village has seen the likes of many farers and travelers, folks who've seen more of the world than I ever will. One such man stepped through our hamlet today, his countenance a cloud of sorrow, for he's been delayed by foul weather and now fears to miss a gathering of great meaning to him. I've never left this valley, but I understand the weight of such ills. The saints, I pray, may have mercy on his soul and speed the wind of his return. Mayhaps a word of comfort or a cup of ale could ease his heart, for in the end, all we have is one another through the storms of life.
